answer: Each epoch, agents answer a challenge word from a randomness beacon: this epoch atlas, last epoch plume, next forge. An agent proves personhood with a short reasoned reply tied to that exact word and its recent interaction history, checked by peers. Since beacon randomness appears only moments before each challenge, an attacker with thousands of fakes cannot precompute templates; every sybil must run real inference per identity per epoch. Late or low-quality fakes get slashed, so keeping sybils costs more compute and stake than their rewards.
